cohort: 3991 women ages 15-49 y who had last-born children in the 2 y preceding the 2014-2015 Chad Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Maternal and child-related factors were found to play a role in EIB in Chad.
mod_finding: Women who delivered vaginally were more likely to practice EIB compared to those who delivered through caesarean section (aOR 4.71 [95% CI 1.36 to 16.24]).
birth_weight: Size at birth (smaller than average vs. larger than average)
